text:
Asha: quick review please 1: draft intro for the product debut blog. Need legal + eng to OK hero claim and CTAs before I move to final. posting copy below so it's in-thread for review.

Asha: Intro: Today Redwood Inference launches a unified runtime that makes LLM inference predictable across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. In our benchmarked scenarios, teams see up to 4x lower per-token costs for production-style workloads.*

Asha: CTAs: Primary: Read the full post. Secondary: Register for the technical webinar (placeholder link).

Evan: love the tone. request: can we add a one-liner about what "production-style workloads" means (average seq len, batching behavior) so readers get context before clicking the appendix?

Marco: suggestion for hero headline: "Run inference where you need it, with predictable cost & latency." Short, clear. will schedule hero comp work. also need alt text for OG image.

Leah: legal flag on any numeric comparators. "up to 4x lower" needs a comparator, period of measurement, and the test conditions. suggest we change to "up to 4x lower per-token cost in our benchmarks" and attach a short methodology note.

Jared: technical note: our internal tests compare Redwood Dedicated tuned defaults vs. an unoptimized open checkpoint on single cloud GPU with naive batching. We can document seq len distribution (8-512 tokens), batching windows, and quantization settings.

LegalBot: automated review: numeric claim present. recommended language: "up to 4x lower per-token cost in our benchmarked scenarios" + link to methodology. Please avoid implying guaranteed savings.

Asha: updating to "up to 4x lower per-token cost in our benchmarked scenarios" and will add an appendix listing model family, hardware, sequence length distribution, batching config, and delta calculations.

Asha: webinar ops: planning a 45-min technical session (30 demo / 15 Q&A). preferred week: Apr 14. need speaker, moderator, and ops owner.

Evan: I can lead the demo and prepare the deck. propose Apr 14 11:00 PT. will include a slide with methodology summary and link to appendix.

Marco: design: mobile-first CTAs stacked, primary button first. hero comp due Apr 7; will upload files to /assets/blog/inference-debut. I'll add OG and 1200x600 hero variants.

Leah: legal will do a quick pass tomorrow morning. we need the appendix available before publish and any customer anecdotes must have written consent + PII redaction.

Asha: Ops info (UTMs + scheduling):
```
utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=inference_debut_apr2026
hubspot_workflow=12345
publish_time=2026-04-09T09:00:00-07:00
primary_cta=Read the full post
secondary_cta=Register for webinar
```

OpsBot: checklist: confirm assets in /assets/blog/inference-debut, confirm OG meta tags, wire HubSpot workflow 12345, set publish window 2026-04-09 09:00 PT, ensure accessibility alt text present.

Asha: action items: Leah legal pass by EOD tomorrow; Evan upload benchmark appendix (CSV + short writeup) by Apr 5; Marco drop hero comps by Apr 7; I'll fold legal notes into final copy after pass.

Leah: :white_check_mark: will do the legal pass tomorrow AM and flag any required changes.

Evan: will upload appendix and benchmark CSV by Apr 5, cc @Jared for any clarifications on methodology.

Marco: noted, hero assets inbound Apr 7, will ping channel when done.

Asha: thanks team. once legal signs off I'll lock the publish window and notify comms and sales for inbound routing. :rocket:

Evan: :thumbsup:

Leah: ack.
